title: Frontend Developer
description: I design and build custom user interfaces that look great and are satisfying to use. Some of that work sits inside Salesforce and Marketing Cloud, where I have built custom applications with a variety of libraries and extensions. I care about the details people feel without naming them: speed, spacing, motion and how a screen behaves on a phone.

title: Marketing Automation Developer
description: My day-to-day at Deloitte is Marketing Cloud: email campaigns, segmentation, automation, triggered communication and custom Journey Builder activities. One recent project was a custom content centre that keeps email, SMS and push in one place, alongside things Marketing Cloud does not offer out of the box, such as stories, web banners and redirections into apps. It saves and pushes to Data Cloud and Salesforce Core at the same time, so everything stays in sync.

title: Avid Learner
description: Learning is what I enjoy most, and AI has made me much faster at it. I can get into a new tool, platform or subject in days, then prove I understand it by building something real with it. That keeps me adaptable and quick to change my approach.

title: AI-driven Developer
description: AI is how I build, not something I reach for now and then. I run agents in parallel, split work between models by what each is good at, and treat context as the real engineering: briefs, instruction files, skills and memory that make the output repeatable instead of lucky. I know how LLMs work well enough to predict where they fail, so I plan, review and own the result while the agents do the typing.
